title: AgentWire (swarmwire): Compact Binary Wire Protocol and Verifiable Policy Runtime for Multi-Agent AI Systems
description: AgentWire (published on PyPI as swarmwire) is a compact, cryptographically verifiable binary wire protocol (AW01) and deterministic policy runtime for multi-agent AI systems. Built with a Rust core and PyO3 Python bindings, it provides static-dictionary + varint binary serialization, constant-time HMAC-SHA256 frame authentication with replay protection, two-phase Reserve/Settle budget accounting, a networked length-prefixed TCP RPC transport, drop-in LangGraph and CrewAI adapters, and a 1:1 lossless live SSE trace decompiler dashboard.
